description: A blowhole's boom with each spout: the air a wave drives out of the cave, a low thump falling in pitch and a whoosh of noise, louder the higher the sea, whole from seaHeight metres (Kiama, Spouting Horn). A point source heard within reach metres. Frequencies in Hz, times in seconds, levels as gains.
